title: nf-core/bacass pipeline - params.input schema (preassembled genomes)
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input to main_preassembled.nf, for genomes that are already assembled (e.g. downloaded from NCBI) rather than assembled from reads.

ID.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

Fasta.errorMessage: Path to an assembled genome FASTA (.fasta/.fa/.fna, optionally gzipped) must be provided
